description: This file defines a custom exception class `RecurringDepositProductNotFoundException` used within the savings portfolio module of the Fineract project. It extends the `AbstractPlatformResourceNotFoundException` to represent a specific 'not found' error related to recurring deposit products identified by their ID.

classes.name: RecurringDepositProductNotFoundException
classes.description: Custom exception thrown when a recurring deposit product with a specified ID does not exist.

methods.name: RecurringDepositProductNotFoundException
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with an error code, message, and the erroneous ID.
